title.narrative: Piloting an integrated knowledge and technology transfer support platform to enable green, clean energy and circular innovation in micro , small and medium sized enterprises in Barbados

description.narrative: The national project in Barbados is part of the GEF and bilateral donor (e.g. Government of Austria) funded Global Program on Climate Resilient Renewable Energy Systems (G-RES), coordinated by UNIDO with the involvement of the Global Network of Regional Sustainable Energy Centres (GN-SEC) and other SIDS partners (see program component under UNIDO Project No. 250231). The global program promotes climate-resilient renewable energy systems in SIDS to strengthen energy security, reduce GHG emissions and dependence on fossil fuels, achieve long-term economic savings from avoided climate-related losses, and deliver adaptation co-benefits for key sectors such as water, agriculture, tourism, as well as the blue economy. The program comprises a global-regional component and individual national "child projects" to be executed in partnership with national institutions. The global-regional component to be executed by UNIDO and the GN-SEC centres will build coherence across the national projects and foster accelerated progress through regional and SIDS-SIDS cooperation, knowledge exchange and technology transfer. After presenting the program, the Government of Barbados has expressed interest to become part of it and provided an endorsement letter for a national "child project", which supports micro-, small-, and medium-s
